**It-cleft:** It + **is / was** + the focus + **who / that** + the rest
*It was **Emma** who found the keys.* · *It's **the noise** that I can't stand.*
- for people — **who / that**, for things, time, place — **that**
- **It is / It was** don't change for number: *It was my parents who…*

**What-cleft:** **What** + subject + V + **is / was** + the focus
*What I need **is** a holiday.* · *What surprised me **was** the price.*
- an action: *What I did **was (to) call** the police.*

**Other frames:** All (that) I want is… · The thing is (that)… · The reason (why) … is that… · The person who… · The place where…
All I want is… — the verb is singular.
All I… is / was… — применшуємо свою дію,: All I… is / was… — we make our action sound small, often to excuse ourselves.
Cleft sentences розбивають речення на дв: Cleft sentences split a sentence into two parts to put the focus on one thing — like stressing a word with your voice or saying “the one thing that annoys me is…”. We use them to correct someone, to stress the main point or to lead up to an important idea.
It ___ (be) the price that put me off. (: It ___ (be) the price that put me off. (past tense)
It is / It was don't change for number.
It was + виділене слово + that…; минулий: It was + the focus word + that…; past tense → was.
It was + виділене слово + who/that…: It was + the focus word + who/that…
It was X who / that… — «саме X, а не хто: It was X who / that… — “X and nobody else”.
It was only when / It was in… that… — у: It was only when / It was in… that… — in stories and texts.
The thing is (that)… — “the point is that”.
The thing is… / The reason why… is that…: The thing is… / The reason why… is that… — often before awkward news or a refusal.
What + підмет + дієслово + is… — виділяє: What + subject + verb + is… — we put the focus on a whole idea.
What I need is… або All I need is…: What I need is… or All I need is…
What I need is… — спершу інтрига, потім: What I need is… — first some suspense, then the main point.
What annoys / worries / surprises me is…: What annoys / worries / surprises me is… — emotional but polite: we criticise the situation, not the person.
What surprised me ___ (be) how friendly: What surprised me ___ (be) how friendly everyone was. (past tense)
What-речення як підмет → дієслово в одни: A What-clause as the subject → singular verb; past tense → was.
Виділення: It is … that, What I need is…: Focus: It is … that, What I need is…
Виділяємо одну річ на противагу іншим: ц: We put the focus on one thing in contrast to others: the price, not the quality.
Головне — наприкінці: The main point at the end
The two parts are joined by was / is, not by a comma.
I noticed the scratch only once I got home.
Лише минулого року я почав серйозно вчит: I started learning English seriously only last year.
The price is the thing that worries me.
For people — who or that, not which.
Підводимо до головного: нове — наприкінц: We lead up to the main point: the new information comes at the end.
Після **What…** дієслово-зв'язка зазвича: After **What…** the linking verb is usually singular: *What we need **is** new ideas.*
Після All не ставимо what: All (that) I: After All we don't use what: All (that) I want…
The point is, we're short of money.
Річ у тім, що я вже пообіцяв допомогти с: The point is, I've already promised to help my sister.
The point is, I forgot my wallet.
